newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Lion to commence trading next week.
newsitem.headline: Lion to commence trading next week.

text.p: Lion Brewery Ltd, which completed an initial public offer (IPO) in December 1996, will start trading on January 22, the stock exchange said on Wednesday.

The company, a subsidiary of Ceylon Brewery Ltd, issued 12.5 million 10-rupee shares, at 20 rupees in November 1996. The issue was oversubscribed within two days, and attracted subscriptions totalling nearly 450 million rupees, a senior company official told Reuters.
Lion Brewery, where Danish brewer Carlsberg has a 24.6 percent stake, raised money to build a plant with a monthly capacity of 30 million litres. -Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
